fields.name: job_name
fields.label: Job name
fields.help: Used to name the predicted mmCIF file.

fields.name: input_json
fields.label: StructurePredictionInput (JSON)
fields.help: JSON representation of ESMFold2's StructurePredictionInput. Sequence entries use type protein, dna, rna, or ligand; polymers take id and sequence, while ligands take id plus either smiles or a ccd list. Native pocket, distogram, covalent-bond, modification, and serialized MSA fields are passed through.
fields.help_note: Modification positions are zero-indexed, exactly as in the official ESMFold2 Python dataclass. Use the JSON-safe shape produced by serialize_structure_prediction_input.

fields.name: num_loops
fields.label: Recycling loops
fields.help: Recycling loops passed to ESMFold2InputBuilder.fold. The released API default is 20.

fields.name: num_sampling_steps
fields.label: Diffusion sampling steps
fields.help: Diffusion sampling steps passed to ESMFold2InputBuilder.fold. The released API default is 200.

fields.name: num_diffusion_samples
fields.label: Diffusion samples
fields.help: Number of independently sampled structures. More than one produces one mmCIF per sample.

fields.name: seed
fields.label: Random seed
fields.help: Seeds input preparation and diffusion sampling.

fields.name: lm_dropout
fields.label: Language-model dropout
fields.help: Inference-time LM embedding dropout. The released folding API defaults to 0.3; set 0 to disable it.

fields.name: chunk_size
fields.label: Pair-operation chunk size
fields.help: Chunk size for memory-heavy pair operations. The released model defaults to 64; smaller values use less memory. Set 0 to disable chunking.

fields.name: device
fields.label: Device
fields.help: Auto selects CUDA when available and otherwise CPU. The published 6B model is intended for GPU inference.

fields.name: precision
fields.label: Model precision
fields.help: Use the checkpoint's published dtype, or explicitly cast model weights to BF16 or FP32.
